Name: Altar Worship

TaskPresentation.Summary: Make ten offerings at the Mileth Altar, three hours apart. Your class determines the final reward.
TaskPresentation.Requirements: 750 gold per Leather Shield · 7,500 gold for ten purchased shields · room in your inventory
TaskPresentation.HowItWorks:
Use a Leather Shield from your bag, or buy one from Torrance in the Mileth Armor Shop for 750 gold. Offer one shield at the Mileth Altar.

Each confirmed offering is saved. Wait three hours before the next; resume the same task to continue. A saved schedule can check at the next offering time.

Priests, Bards and Master Priests earn the Mileth Altar Worshipper legend, a Jade or Amethyst Ring and 100,000 experience. Other classes receive a Red Jade Ring and 50,000 experience after the tenth offering, with an acknowledgement before starting.

The quest and task share the same progress and schedules. Completion requires a verified reward after the tenth offering.

OutcomeConditions: Each offering: one Leather Shield dropped on the Mileth Altar leaves the bag and the server answers "You feel a touch of light around you"
Offerings are made 3 hours apart; the quest stops after the 10th
Completion: Priests show "Mileth Altar Worshipper" in their own legend; other classes receive a new Red Jade Ring
